name: SVGator
category: A9. Adjacent resources mentioned during discovery
role: Browser SaaS editor for animated SVG; no public render API found
summary: Commercial web app for animating SVG visually, exporting animated SVG (CSS or JS), Lottie, and on higher plans video or GIF. Driven through its editor UI; the site lists a Player API for playback control and an MCP integration with no documented detail. Strength is a visual authoring workflow with no code.
use_when: A designer authors the animation in a GUI and you only embed the exported SVG
avoid_when: Scripted SVG animation: GSAP or SVG.js with a seekable timeline
Lottie assets: dotLottie or Lottie Web with a Lottie authored in After Effects
Deterministic capture: export then drive via the SVG toolchain, not the SaaS
license: Commercial SaaS (free tier; video export on Team plan)

assessment.rationale: No CLI or documented authoring API; the product is a GUI. Output is an animated SVG that GSAP and Inkscape-based flows reproduce in code. Release cadence of a SaaS is not published.

notes: 2026-10-26: the listed MCP integration was not documented on the fetched page; if it is real and scriptable, reassess.
